theme_archetype.archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Adapted for Construction Field Work)
theme_archetype.description: A tactical, no-nonsense UI designed for field technicians wearing gloves outdoors. Focuses on high-contrast legibility, massive touch targets, and offline-first ruggedness. No fragile glassmorphism. No soft shadows. Hard lines and safety colors.

global_rules: DO NOT use generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for Headings.
Headings must be robust, condensed, and heavy.
Body text must have increased tracking for outdoor glare legibility.

families.body: IBM Plex Sans or Chivo (Medium/500 weight)

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5A00] rounded-md min-h-[64px] flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-transparent active:border-white
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#52525B] min-h-[64px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-md active:bg-[#27272A]
buttons.anomaly_persistent: bg-[#FF3B30] rounded-md min-h-[64px] flex-row items-center justify-center px-4 absolute bottom-6 right-6 left-6 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,59,48,0.5)] z-50

inputs.text_field: bg-black border-2 border-[#3F3F46] rounded-md min-h-[64px] px-4 text-white text-xl focus:border-[#FF5A00]
inputs.label: text-sm text-[#A1A1AA] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2

cards.project_card: bg-[#18181B] border border-[#3F3F46] p-5 rounded-lg mb-4 flex-col gap-2
cards.status_badge: px-3 py-1 rounded-sm text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider self-start

visual_schema.wrapper: relative w-full aspect-square bg-[#0C0C0E] border-2 border-[#3F3F46] rounded-lg items-center justify-center p-8
visual_schema.measurement_input_overlay: absolute bg-black border-2 border-[#FF5A00] rounded-md min-w-[80px] h-[50px] flex items-center justify-center text-center text-white font-bold text-lg

auth.layout: Centered form, massive logo, role selector via large distinct touch cards (Admin, Commercial, Technician).

dashboard.layout: Sticky top search bar (h-16). Horizontal scrollable filter chips (h-12). Flat list of Project Cards.

project_detail.layout: Client info header (solid #18181B bg). List of measurements. Massive 'Ajouter une ouverture' dashed-border button at the bottom.

measurement_form.layout: Top: Block Type Selector (4 horizontal thick tabs). Middle: Visual Schema Box (SVG drawing of Standard/Coulissant/Porte/Trapèze with overlay inputs). Bottom: Capture Photo Button. Footer: Persistent Anomaly Red Button.

motion_and_haptics.buttons: Opacity feedback on press (activeOpacity={0.7}). Trigger heavy haptic feedback on 'Signaler une anomalie' and 'Clôturer'. Trigger light haptic on measurements input.

testing_requirements.description: Since this is React Native, use testID instead of data-testid. ALL interactive elements MUST have a testID.

login_background.description: Dark, industrial construction worker background to be used with a 80% black overlay (bg-black/80).

schema_texture.description: Blueprint texture. Can be blended at 5% opacity into the visual schema wrapper for a technical feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native app. Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput.
Do NOT use Shadcn UI. Use React Native components with NativeWind className props for styling.

For the dynamic measurement visual schemas, use 'react-native-svg'. Render the window frame as SVG paths with stroke='#52525B' and use 'position: absolute' on TextInput components to place them logically around the edges (top, bottom, left, right, diagonals).
Touch targets are critical: Every button or input MUST have a minimum height of 64px (h-16).
Implement the 'Signaler une anomalie' button as a persistent absolute View at the bottom of the measurement screens with a high z-index.
Apply testID to all touchable elements and inputs using kebab-case role-based names.
